The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1937–1938''' was contested by 51 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]] won this year's championship by beating [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]], [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[Be Quick 1887]] and [[PSV Eindhoven]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[HVV Hengelo]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[sc Heerenveen]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[KFC (football club)|KFC]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]] [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]] and [[VUC (football club)|VUC]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[RFC Rotterdam]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]], [[CVV Mercurius]], [[DHC Delft]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]] and [[XerxesDZB|Xerxes]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[HVV 't Gooi]]
